stem: Which event names a force as a push or pull between two objects?

options.text: Vikram kicks a football — a push between his foot and the ball
A ball sits still on grass — the ball applies a force to itself
Noor pulls a wagon — the pull acts only on the wagon
A leaf falls — no objects are interacting

rows: a push between his foot and the ball
A ball sits still on grass
the ball applies a force to itself
the pull acts only on the wagon

teacher.key_rationale: A force is a push or pull between two objects. The kick is that. A ball does not push itself. A pull is between Noor and the wagon. A falling leaf still interacts with Earth.
